notes.title: PATCH 1.3 - BOUNCE now supports the Oculus Touch!
notes.notes:
Good news everyone!

Bounce now supports the Oculus Touch. In today's patch, the following features have been added for Oculus Touch players:


An Oculus Touch specific tutorial has been added. 
New crouch controls added.
New 15 degree rotation controls added.
New teleport facing controls added.


In other news, we've started working the convention circuit. Recently, we used a private meeting space at GDC and had a full booth at the San Jose SVVR. Next up, we'll have a booth at the Silicon Valley Comic Con from Friday April 21 to Sunday April 23 2017.

We'll be showing off Mars: Odyssey and Bounce next to the Space Village. 



-jtop

notes.title: Bounce Patch 1.2
notes.notes:
Happy 2017!!!
We released a patch for Bounce today. 


The leaderboards have been updated to retrieve information faster.
A "Delete Save Game" function has been added to the Hub. NOTE: If you delete the game you currently have loaded, you will automatically jump to the tutorial. 
Holiday cheer has come and gone. It shall return to the Hub next year!

notes.title: Bounce Patch 1.1
notes.notes:
First Patch is Live!  


 Level Complete screen is now located on the left controller and no longer over the exit point. No longer need to worry about gadgets clipping through the menu!

 Adjusted SFX to level 50.

 Slight level adjustments for level 21.

 Adjustments to the Hub Room level select menu.
  
 Added a little Holiday cheer to the Hub room!
